_note: 'expects' is a substring of the URL the question should reach. null means
the question is about something this site does not have, so returning any
page at all is a false accept: the assistant would then hand a model a
question with irrelevant material and get a confident irrelevant answer.
Written by the developer against the demo site, which is the honest limit
of what this measures. Real calibration needs questions real learners
actually typed, and the number should be recomputed once there are some.

Grade questions were added once the assistant could answer them. Several name no page at all — 'ยังสอบได้อีกกี่ครั้ง' — which is exactly the case the kind keywords exist for, so they belong in the calibration.
